rendering_rules.rule: a value type whose domain is root ordinal 2 (nat) with schema Nat(m) is carried by Fin (m + 1)
the root ordinal 1 (bool) value type is carried by Bool
a ProverMessage occurrence is a monadic bind of the strategy's decision at that point applied to its guaranteed reads in view order
a Challenge occurrence under the Fresh interpretation is a monadic bind of its public-coin law parameter
an InvokeCheck occurrence is a let-binding of the Check's denotation parameter applied to its ordered inputs

a guarded ReachTerminal occurrence is an if on the guard's denotation parameter applied to its inputs; the unconditional final ReachTerminal is the else branch; first-active selection is the if/else order
the Verdict inductive has one constructor per Terminal in Core order named by its verdict
